name: encrypted-backup
description: Set up, run, check, and restore an encrypted 3-2-1 backup for sensitive local directories (financial, health, legal, or other private records). Local git history plus an encrypted, deduplicated restic repo mirrored to a second local drive and an offsite cloud remote (Google Drive, OneDrive, Proton Drive, or any rclone-supported backend) — no plaintext ever leaves the machine. Works on Linux, macOS, and Windows (Git Bash or WSL).
